name: chained-problem-sets
does: Problems asked in parts: each set from the course's CHAINS (a data file listed in course.js `files`) is worked in the order the professor asks its parts, with the shared vignette above each part; a part met on its own says which set it belongs to and offers the set; on an exam paper the parts of one set sit together, in order. Each part's stem states the earlier results it uses.
source: Basic-Pharmacokinetics src/views.js startChain, CHAIN_OF, paperOrder and the quiz card's set lines (lines 888-911, 1548-1565, 1727-1733, 1748, 1798-1804, 3209-3222) and src/test.js sections 5c and the stated-results check (lines 512-548, 760-790), at ac2eb73
